sections.text:
The METI directional relay detects 
the phase angle of the current in a power system and when used in conjunction 
with over current relay type MCGG provides directional control of the time 
delayed element.

The MCGG is a microprocessor based 
over-current relay available in single, two, three or four pole versions 
manufactured by GEC ALSTHOM. Each pole is provided with a choice of four inverse 
time characteristics and three definite time characteristics as well as a trip 
test position. An instantaneous element is also available on each phase. The 
MCGG 22 is the single phase version.

The first draft initiated, tested by eng. Hany 
Bassuony Abdel Razek, accepted by UEEPC general manager eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab 
inspection & quality control 
head sector, 
and approved by Dr. Tharwat sabry.
